VISUAL CONTEXT
The image is a detailed architectural cross-section of a sloping roof and valley gutter construction. A red, hand-drawn loop highlights the upper sloping roof build-up showing a tapered profile transitioning between a 9° slope at the top surface and a 17° slope along the underlying insulated substrate. Multiple layers are illustrated and annotated, including a VM Zinc roof finish, zinc membrane, two layers of insulation totaling 160 mm, a vapour control layer (VCL), and timber support framing alongside a box valley gutter with specified maximum depths and falls.
